method.referenceChecks: Regulation Z, 12 CFR part 1026, Appendix J: the iteration of paragraph (b)(9) and the examples of paragraphs (c)(1) and (c)(3)
method.unitPeriods: Appendix J (b)(5)(ii) to (iv): full unit-periods and the fraction from the dates of the advance and the first payment
method.apr: Appendix J (b)(8) general equation, solved by the (b)(9) iteration until the rate changes by less than 1e-10 percent
method.tolerance: 12 CFR 1026.22(a)(2) and (a)(3), read from the served text
method.schedule: interest each unit-period is the balance times the unrounded periodic rate, rounded half up to the cent
